dialogue.content: こんにちは、あーみんさん。本日宜しくお願い致します。あーみんさんのご準備ができましたら、お知らせください。
dialogue.English: Hello, A-min. It's a pleasure to speak with you today. Please let me know when you are ready to begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you, I'm ready.

dialogue.content: 始めてくださいませ
dialogue.English: Please go ahead and begin.

dialogue.content: はい。では始めさせて頂きます。宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Alright. Let's get started then. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. To begin, could you tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: ４０代女性子供の不登校での悩みです
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s, and I'm struggling with my child's school refusal.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。それはとても悩まれますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. That must be very distressing for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく不登校の状況をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about the situation with the school refusal?

dialogue.content: はい小学生の子供が半年前から急に学校に行きたくないと言い出して
dialogue.English: Yes, my elementary school-aged child suddenly started saying they didn't want to go to school about six months ago.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは親としてとても心配ですよね
dialogue.English: As a parent, that must be incredibly concerning.

dialogue.content: 最初は学校を休みがちだったのですが、最近は全く行きたがらずにずっと休んでいます
dialogue.English: At first, they were just missing school occasionally, but recently, they don't want to go at all and have been continuously absent.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心配で夜も良く眠れません
dialogue.English: I'm so worried I can't sleep well at night.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それはとてもお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: お子さんは今何年生ですか？
dialogue.English: What grade is your child in now?

dialogue.content: ５年生です
dialogue.English: Fifth grade.

dialogue.content: 行きづらくなったのは４年生からですか？
dialogue.English: Did they start having difficulty going to school in the 4th grade?

dialogue.content: いいえ、５年生になってクラス替えがあってからです
dialogue.English: No, it started after they moved up to the 5th grade and the classes were reshuffled.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So that's what happened.

dialogue.content: それはコロナの状況もある中、とてもご心配だと思います。
dialogue.English: With the COVID situation on top of that, I can imagine you must be very worried.

dialogue.content: 仲良しのお友達ともクラスが離れてしまって・・とても寂しそうでした
dialogue.English: They were separated from their close friends in the class change... They seemed very lonely.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。仲良しの友達と離れるのはお子さんにとって寂しいと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. Being separated from close friends must be lonely for your child.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお子さんは性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, may I ask your child's gender?

dialogue.content: 男の子です
dialogue.English: He's a boy.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。男の子も高学年になるといろいろ友達の合う合わないが出てくる年ごろだと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I think that as boys get into the upper elementary grades, it's an age where issues of getting along with friends start to come up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生とは連絡を取られていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you been in contact with his homeroom teacher?

dialogue.content: あまりとってないですね私がフルで仕事をしていて時間的に余裕がないです
dialogue.English: Not really. I work full-time, so I don't have much time.

dialogue.content: 今年はコロナで家庭訪問もなかったですし・・
dialogue.English: And because of COVID, there were no home visits this year either.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだったんですね。それはお子さんのことと仕事で本当にエネルギーを使われて大変だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it was. It must be very exhausting managing your son's situation and your work.

dialogue.content: 授業参観も中止でした
dialogue.English: Class observations were canceled as well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうですね、確かに今年は家庭訪問もや参観もなく子ども同士や担任の先生との関係作りも作りづらいですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true. With no home visits or class observations this year, it's difficult for children to build relationships with each other and with their teacher.

dialogue.content: 学校での様子が良く解らないのも心配です
dialogue.English: I'm also worried because I don't really know how he's doing at school.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。それは親として心配な要因の1つだと思います。
dialogue.English: I understand. I think that's one of the factors that would worry any parent.

dialogue.content: そんな中親御さんだけでよくお子さんを支えられてとても気を張っておられたと思います。
dialogue.English: In the midst of all that, I think you've done so well supporting your son on your own. You must have been under a lot of strain.

dialogue.content: 子供ももともと口数が少なくて、家でもゲームばかりしていてあまり話してくれない子なので、ますます心配です
dialogue.English: My son has always been a quiet child, and at home, he just plays video games and doesn't talk much, which makes me even more worried.

dialogue.content: はい、それは親としてなおさら心配ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that would make you all the more concerned as a parent.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事をフルでされているということはお子さんは日中一人でゲームして待たれているのですか？
dialogue.English: Since you work full-time, does that mean your son is at home alone during the day, playing games?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは仕事しながらもとても気が気でないですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very unsettling, trying to work while worrying about him.

dialogue.content: 朝早く出かけて夕方７時過ぎに帰宅するので、心配です
dialogue.English: I leave early in the morning and don't get home until after 7 p.m., so I'm worried.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine.

dialogue.content: 仕事中も気になってしまいます
dialogue.English: I find myself worrying about him even during work.

dialogue.content: そんな中でもよく仕事も休まず子育てと両立されていると思います。
dialogue.English: Even so, I think you are doing a great job balancing your work and parenting without taking time off.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: あまり眠られてないとのことですが、少しは休む時間も取れそうですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you haven't been sleeping well, but are you able to get any time to rest?

dialogue.content: ほんとうは平日もお休みが取れれば、もう少し子供と向き合えるかな・・とも思うのですが
dialogue.English: Honestly, if I could take a day off during the week, I feel like I could connect with my son a little more, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なかなか仕事も休みづらいことあると思います。
dialogue.English: I'm sure it's difficult to take time off from work.

dialogue.content: おこさんとは食事など一緒にしたり、1日1回は会話されていますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have meals together with your son, or talk with him at least once a day?

dialogue.content: 土日や祭日はお休みなのですが、たまった家事に追われてしまい子供と向き合えていないかもしません
dialogue.English: I have weekends and holidays off, but I get caught up in all the housework that's piled up, so I might not be properly connecting with him.

dialogue.content: 平日は夕食の時に話す時間はありますが、子供からはほとんど話てくれなくて・・
dialogue.English: On weekdays, we have time to talk at dinner, but he rarely says anything to me...

dialogue.content: ４年生頃までは良く話をしていたんですけどね
dialogue.English: Up until around fourth grade, he used to talk a lot.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。あまりお話できない状態なんですね。気持ちが見えないと余計不安になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're not able to talk much right now. When you can't see how he's feeling, it makes you feel even more anxious, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: でも家事も大切な日常の仕事なので、それもこなしていることはとてもすごい力がいることです。
dialogue.English: But housework is also an important daily task, and the fact that you're managing that too takes a tremendous amount of strength.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: まずすべての事を一生懸命こなしているあなたの毎日は、とてもすごいことですよ。
dialogue.English: First of all, the way you handle everything with such dedication every day is truly amazing.

dialogue.content: 子供の気持ちがわかってあげたいと思っていいるのですが、子供が話をしたがらないので、本当に困ってしまいます
dialogue.English: I want to understand my child's feelings, but he doesn't want to talk, so I'm really at a loss.

dialogue.content: 親としてどうなんだろうって・・考えてしまいます
dialogue.English: It makes me wonder what I'm doing wrong as a parent...

dialogue.content: ええ、お子さんが話をされないのは、親として心の中がみえず不安や心配が募ると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. When your child doesn't talk, as a parent it's hard to see what's in his heart, and I imagine the anxiety and worry build up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもお子さんにとって家が心の休まる場所だから、今学校に行けなくてもご自宅で心を休めていると思いますが、どうですか？
dialogue.English: But perhaps because home is a place where your son can feel at ease, even if he can't go to school right now, he's able to rest his mind at home. What do you think?

dialogue.content: いいえ、子供は学校に行きたくても行けないので苦しいんだと
dialogue.English: No, I think my child is suffering because he wants to go to school but can't.

dialogue.content: 思います
dialogue.English: That's what I think.

dialogue.content: 毎日ゲームに逃げているように思います
dialogue.English: I feel like he's escaping into games every day.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。すみません。お子さん苦しまれていますよね。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'm sorry. Your son is suffering, isn't he?

dialogue.content: ４年までは学校が好きで楽しそうに行っていましたから
dialogue.English: Up until 4th grade, he loved school and seemed to enjoy going.

dialogue.content: 行きたいのに行けない今はとても辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: Wanting to go but not being able to must be very painful for him right now.

dialogue.content: その苦しみを何とか親としてわかってあげたいと思っているのに、それさえできない自分が情けなく思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: As his parent, I want so desperately to understand that pain, but I can't even do that, and I feel so pathetic.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね。隣で子どもが苦しんでいるのに、変わってあげることもできず見守るのは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. It's painful to watch your child suffer right beside you, unable to take their place.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいんでしょうか
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: お子さんが行きたくないと言って家にいれるのは、あなたがありのままのお子さんを受け止めているからだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think the fact that your son can say he doesn't want to go and be allowed to stay home is because you are accepting him just as he is.

dialogue.content: いいえ、学校に行かないのなら家にしかいるしかないですよよね
dialogue.English: No, if he doesn't go to school, he has no choice but to be at home, right?

dialogue.content: 最初学校に行きたくないと言っても、休ませずに無理やり行きなさいと叱りつけていました
dialogue.English: At first, when he said he didn't want to go to school, I wouldn't let him stay home and would scold him and force him to go.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.content: それからどうされたのですか？
dialogue.English: And what did you do after that?

dialogue.content: でも、子供は学校に行っても学校には入らず帰ってきてしまったり・・仕事先に学校から連絡がありわかりました
dialogue.English: But even if he went to school, he wouldn't go inside and would just come back home... I found out because the school called me at work.

dialogue.content: 本当に学校に行くのが苦痛だったのだと思います
dialogue.English: I think going to school was truly agonizing for him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは本当に驚かれたと思いますし、仕事でも大変でしたよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been a real shock, and it must have been difficult for you at work as well.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生とは電話で話をしたのですが、クラスに馴染めずに友達もいないようでした
dialogue.English: I spoke with his homeroom teacher on the phone, and it seems he wasn't fitting in with the class and didn't have any friends.

dialogue.content: ええ、お子さんの心の痛みを知って親としても辛いですよね。どうしたらよいかわからなくなるのは当然です。
dialogue.English: Yes, learning about your child's emotional pain must be painful for you as a parent, too. It's natural to not know what to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、友達がいないとクラスに居場所がないと感じてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, without friends, a child can feel like they have no place in the classroom.

dialogue.content: お子さんにとって一番つらい環境は、自分の居場所がなくなることではないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: For your child, might not the most painful thing be losing his sense of belonging?

dialogue.content: 行けないことすら言えず学校に無理をして通い、結果自分の居場所を失って、生きることさえできなくなることもあります。
dialogue.English: Sometimes, children force themselves to go to school without even being able to say they can't, and as a result, they lose their sense of belonging and can even lose the will to live.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか・・それは心配です担任の先生も心配してくださっている様子ですが。
dialogue.English: Is that so... That's worrying. His teacher seems concerned as well, though.

dialogue.content: はい。でもあなたはその前にお子さんも心の痛みを受け止めて、家にいる選択を尊重しています。
dialogue.English: Yes. But before it got to that point, you acknowledged your son's emotional pain and respected his choice to stay home.

dialogue.content: 先生からも子供の話を良く聞くようにと言われているのですが・・
dialogue.English: The teacher also told me to listen carefully to what my son has to say, but...

dialogue.content: とにかくゲームばかりしていて、口を閉ざしていて困っています
dialogue.English: He just plays video games all the time and won't open up, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。確かに話してくれないのは心配ですよね。でもお子さんにとって今のありのままの自分を受け止めてもらっていると感じているのではないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. It's certainly worrying when he won't talk to you. But don't you think that for your son, he might feel that you are accepting him just as he is right now?

dialogue.content: 今の自分のやり場のない辛さをまだ子どもなりにゲームで消化しようとすることもあると思います。ただ親として心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: I think it's also possible that, in his own childish way, he's trying to process his current unmanageable pain through video games. Of course, as a parent, it's worrying.

dialogue.content: 家にいることを尊重している気持ちではないのですが、学校に無理やり行かせようにも行かないので仕方がないという感じです
dialogue.English: It's not that I'm respecting his choice to stay home; it's more that I have no choice because he won't go even if I try to force him.

dialogue.content: 以前のように学校に行って欲しいのです
dialogue.English: I want him to go to school like he used to.

dialogue.content: ええ、あなたの葛藤されているのですよね。そうだと思います。親ならそう感じるのもよく分かります。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're conflicted, aren't you? I understand. It's completely understandable for a parent to feel that way.

dialogue.content: ゲームばかりしていて、これから先どうなってしまうんだろう・・ととても心配でいたたまれなくなります
dialogue.English: He just plays games all the time, and I get so unbearably worried thinking about what will happen to him in the future.

dialogue.content: 勉強もして欲しいのに・・
dialogue.English: And I want him to study, too...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。不登校のお子さんは今学校に行く心のエネルギーがない状態です。しかし20歳以下の不登校のお子さんの80％の方は進学や就職を選択されているデータもあります。
dialogue.English: I understand. Children who refuse to go to school are often in a state where they don't have the mental energy to go. However, there is data showing that 80% of people under 20 who experience school refusal go on to higher education or find employment.

dialogue.content: どうしたらまた学校に行ってくれるようになるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What can I do to help him start going to school again?

dialogue.content: 学校に行くエネルギーがないのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is it that he doesn't have the energy to go to school?

dialogue.content: そうですね。例えば少し10分だけ一緒に登校するのからスタートはどうですか？
dialogue.English: That's right. For example, how about starting by just walking to school with him for 10 minutes?

dialogue.content: ますます絶望的でうすよね
dialogue.English: That just makes it feel more hopeless.

dialogue.content: そんなことは決してありません。
dialogue.English: That's not true at all.

dialogue.content: 提案ありがたいのですが、それをするには私自身が仕事を変えるしか方法がありません
dialogue.English: I appreciate the suggestion, but for me to do that, the only way would be to change my job.

dialogue.content: かならず心はまた充電されたら動き出せます。
dialogue.English: Once his heart is recharged, he will definitely be able to move forward again.

dialogue.content: ええ、それは難しいなら別の方法を模索しましょう。
dialogue.English: I see. If that's difficult, let's explore other options.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくないという本人の気持ちをわからなければ・・と思うのですが
dialogue.English: I feel like I need to understand his feelings about not wanting to go to school, but...

dialogue.content: ええ。今でも十分寄り添おうとされていると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think you are already trying your best to be there for him.

dialogue.content: 学校に行くようなエネルギーを充電するにはどうしたらいいんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How can I help him recharge his energy so he can go to school?

dialogue.content: 行けないお子さんの心を何とかしようとこうして相談してくださっているのですよね。すごくお子さんを尊重されていると思います。
dialogue.English: You've come here today seeking advice because you want to do something to help your son's state of mind. I think that shows a great deal of respect for him.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず、お子さんが今家にいたいなら無理せず家で過ごすのもよいと思います。
dialogue.English: First, if your son wants to be at home right now, I think it's okay to let him stay at home without forcing him.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: でもゲームばかりしていて、とても心配でです
dialogue.English: But he's just playing games all the time, and I'm very worried.

dialogue.content: はい。勉強は確かに心配ですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes. I understand your concern about his studies.

dialogue.content: そこは学校の先生とも相談してプリント学習の手助けをしてもらうのはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: In that regard, how about discussing it with his teacher and asking for their help with worksheet-based learning?

dialogue.content: 毎日課題をいきなりはしんどくても、ほんの少しできることから始めて増やしていくのも1つだと思います。
dialogue.English: Even if daily assignments are too much at first, one approach is to start with just a little that he can manage and gradually increase from there.

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたくなっても勉強についていけないのでは？と不安に思っていたので今度先生と勉強のことで相談してみます
dialogue.English: I was worried that even if he wanted to go back to school, he wouldn't be able to keep up with his studies, so I'll try talking to his teacher about it.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それはとても良いと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that's a very good idea.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right.

dialogue.content: もうお時間なので相談をまとめてみてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up, so may I summarize our conversation?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今不登校のお子さんがゲームばかりでこれからがとても心配だが、仕事もあり子どもにつきっきりで向き合うことはできない状況である。何とか学校に行ってほしい、元気になってほしい気持ちがあり、一方でその辛さを変われない気持ちとで、親としてとても悩んでいる。勉強のことは今後担任の先生と相談しながら少しづつ取り組んでいけるよう、働きかけてみようと思った。このような状況でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, you are very worried about your son who is refusing to go to school and just playing video games, but due to your work, you are not in a position to be with him all the time. You want him to go to school and get better, but at the same time, you feel helpless because you can't take away his pain, and as a parent, you are very distressed. You've decided to talk with his teacher about his studies and see if you can work on getting him to do a little bit at a time. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お子さんに学校に行って欲しいと願うのは親として当たり前の気持ちです。仕事も家事もこなしながらそれでもこうして今日お子さんの気持ちに寄り添いたい、何とかしたいとここにきてくださいました。
dialogue.English: Wanting your son to go to school is a perfectly natural feeling for a parent. While managing both work and housework, you still came here today because you want to be there for your son and do something to help.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それだけでも十分親として今思いたることをしようとされているのだと感じ、本当に頑張っておられると思います。
dialogue.English: That alone shows me that you are trying to do what you feel is best as a parent right now, and I think you are doing a wonderful job.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お子さんはあなたのそんな迷いや深い愛を感じているからこそ、今家でゲームをするものの何とか苦しい中過ごしていると感じました。
dialogue.English: I feel that your son senses your internal conflict and your deep love, and that's why, although he's playing video games at home, he's somehow managing to get through this difficult time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本日はここまでの相談ですが、そんな頑張っておられるご自身のことも時には休ませてあげてください。
dialogue.English: That's all for our session today, but please make sure to let yourself rest sometimes, too. You are working so hard.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。担任の先生とももう少し時間をとって話してみようかと思います
dialogue.English: Thank you. I think I'll try to make a bit more time to talk with his homeroom teacher.

dialogue.content: そしてここや担任の先生など、お一人で抱え込まずにお子さんの未来を一緒に考えていけると良いと思っています。
dialogue.English: And I hope you can continue to think about your son's future together with others, like me or his teacher, without trying to carry the burden all by yourself.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: はい、ぜひ周囲の助けも借りてみてください。これからの時間を応援しております。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do seek help from those around you. I’ll be rooting for you.

dialogue.content: 本日はここで相談を終了させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we end today's session here?

dialogue.content: 相談して少し楽になったように思うので、いろんな方に相談してみるのもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: I feel a little better after talking with you, so maybe talking to various people is a good idea.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、ぜひいろんな方の意見も聞いてみてくださいね。こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do listen to various people's perspectives. Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これでロールプレイを終了してよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May we end the role-play now?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.
